Survival basics

Prepare protection and an exit before entering a radiation zone

Check breathing protection, clothing and treatment supplies before entering. Identify a return route, watch the warning sound and status indicators, and leave if your protection is insufficient or your condition keeps worsening.

The source separates lung and body protection, a useful equipment checklist. Its exact thresholds, damage rates and treatment claims have not been verified on current servers; do not use them to calculate a safe stay.
